fields.value: SNN Raj Etternia, Sy no.146/1,147/1,147/2,145/1,144 of Kudlu village, Sarjapura Hobli, Harlur Road, Anekal Taluk, Bangalore – 560 068. Total extent of land under Phase 1, 15 Acres 23 Guntas, 63,029.31 Sq. Mtrs. and we have land area of 21 Acres 09 Guntas under future expansion. Phase 1 will Consists of 5 Blocks ABCDE. Towers ABC completion date is by March 2019 Including Grace Period, D Block completion is by October 2019 including grace period. Block E is still on the drawing boards and will take some time to launch. ABCD Blocks have 2 Basements for Car Park with G+ 18 Building. The Project Have 1,2,3,4 and Penthouse Apartments. All The four Towers open to a Large Central Park. The Salient Feature of the Project are 1) Full Height & Bay Windows for most Apartments 2) Unique Cascading Swimming Pool with 5 Zones 3) Sky Garden on 9 different Open Terrance 4) Large Central Park in the center of the project One of the fastest selling project in Bangalore and has won “Best Luxury Project in Bangalore” by Berg Singapore and Bangalore Real Estate Awards.

fields.value: SNN Raj Lakeview Ph. 2, BTM 2nd Stage, Bangalore 560076. This Project is abutting SNN Raj Lakeview Phase-1 and the Madiwala Lake. It is spread on 3 Acres 31 Guntas consisting of 184 Units of 3 and 4 BHK Apartments and one Basement Parking. The Apartment size varies from 1575 to 6600 Sqft Apartments. OC obtained and handed over to owners with a proper Association in place. The Project has been awarded as “The Best Luxury Project “in Bangalore by Axis Bank & Silicon India Real Estate Awards. The Project Amenities of both SNN Raj Lakeview Phase 1 and Phase 2 are 1) Bowling Alley 2) Heated Pool 3) Outdoor Swimming Pool 4) Badminton Court – 2 No 5) Squash Court 6) Spa / Health Club 7) Swimming Pool 8) Indoor Games – Billiards , Table Tennis, Carom, Chess 9) Party Hall 10) Yoga / Meditation Room 11) Gym 12) Console Gaming Zone 13) Music & Dance Room 14) Tennis Court 15) Basketball Court 16) Mini Soccer Ground 17) Children Play Area 18) Amphitheater

fields.label: Project Description
fields.value: SNN Raj Serenity, Begur Road, Off Bannerghatta Road, Bangalore –The Project Has G+13 Floors, 1872 Units of 2, 3 and 4 BHK Apartments– ABCDEP Blocks have been completed, OC obtained and handed over to owners with a proper Association in place. Club Serenity is one of the biggest club house in Bangalore with an array of amenities like 3 Badminton Courts, Squash Court, 3 Party Halls, Sky Lounge, SPA, Beauty Saloon, YOGA/ Aerobic Zone, Gym, Indoor Games- Chess, Carom, Billiards, Snooker, Table Tennis, separate Tiny Tot play section, Console Gaming section, 2 Swimming Pools, Cards Room, Home Theater Room, Reading Zone. The Outdoor Amenities of the project include 2 tennis court, Skating zone, Basketball Court, Mini Soccer ground, Cricket Practice Pitch, Children Play area and Pet Zone. – The Project has won the following awards: 1) Best Mid-Segment Project CNBC Awaaz 2) Best Mid-Segment Project in Bangalore, by LIC Housing Finance 3) Best Concept and Architecture Residential Project, by Business Leadership Excellence Awards, Brands Academy 4) Best Clubhouse in Residential Project in South India, by Berg Singapore 5) Best Project Amenities (Residential – mid Segment) Hindustan Ratna Real Estate Award , by Hindustan Times Group. Serenity is close to a Natural Lake and another Man Made lake inside the project and is spread on 30 Acres of land – we have already developed 24 acres and have a parcel of 7 acres for future expansion.

fields.value: SNN Clermont, BBMP Khatha No:53/1,54/1-55, SY NO.54/1,53/1, 55 & 56, Nagawara Village, Ward No.23, Bangalore 560 045. Located on Outer Ring Road, facing the Nagawara Lake, SNN Clermont has the best location in Hebbal close to Manyata Tech Park and next to upcoming Hotel. The proposed area to be constructed: 2,26,062.24 Sq. Mtrs in a land area of 7 Acres 28 Guntas. The Project Consist of 5 towers of 40 Floors each with 2 Basements. It has 427 Apartments of 3, 4, 5 BHK apartments along with Penthouse. All the apartments have ample cross ventilation and brightness. Tower 1,2,3 and 5 has 3 Lifts for two apartment per floor. Tower 1 and 2 completion by March 2019 including Grace period and Towers 3, 4, 4V and 5 completion date by October 2020 Including Grace Period. Clermont has a Club House and Sport Complex has the following amenities 1) Outdoor Swimming Pool 2) Indoor Heated Swimming Pool 3) Tennis Court 4) Golf Simulator 5) Badminton Court 6) Beach Volleyball 7) Basketball 8) Squash Court 9) Skating Area 10) Walking / Jogging Tracks 11) Billiards / Pool Tables 12) Gym 13) Health Club / Spa 14) Guest Suites 15) Mini Theater 16) Banquet Hall 17) Children’s Place Area 18) Provision of Coffee Shop 19) Reading Rooms 20) Conference Room Tallest & Best in Hebbal, this project has won awards from RealtyPlus Magazine and Estrade Singapore.

Most of the apartments are Vaastu Compliant.
